steps.title: Now write about your own thirty-day challenge: what it is, and how you are going to do it.
steps.model: I’m going to … this year. / I’m not going to … any more.

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ talk about an intention — I’m going to spend a day offline
✓ talk about an arrangement — I’m meeting a friend at one o’clock
✓ make both negative — I’m not going to check my email , I’m not working on Friday
✓ ask about somebody’s week — Are you doing anything on Friday? , How are you going to do it?
✓ hear going to when it is said fast
✓ talk about being online — go online, log on, download, share, switch off, waste time
